title: Wanderer in Apocalypse
description: A man in a tan trench coat stands on a cracked road holding a briefcase, facing a monstrous floating female creature with purple skin, long flowing purple hair, and multiple arms. The creature reaches toward a glowing green star as a blood-red moon drips above a ruined cityscape filled with abandoned shopping carts, film reels, lightning, and toxic puddles under an apocalyptic sky with aurora and fire.
prompt: A lone man in a tan trench coat stands with his back to the viewer on a broken asphalt road, holding a briefcase, facing a giant floating purple-skinned female monster with wild purple hair, multiple clawed arms, and an open screaming mouth. She reaches for a glowing green star in the sky. A massive blood-red moon drips red liquid above a dystopian ruined city with abandoned shopping carts, film reels, chain-link fences, and derelict buildings. Lightning strikes, toxic puddles reflect the sky, dark clouds and green aurora fill the dramatic apocalyptic atmosphere.
